2026_02_CAR_ATL.headline: Rush gets the call as Carolina tries to squeeze Atlanta’s passing game
2026_02_CAR_ATL.paragraph1: Atlanta will start Cooper Rush with Michael Penix Jr. ruled out again, removing the quarterback uncertainty that shaped the Falcons’ preparation earlier in the week. Carolina enters the NFC South matchup needing a cleaner response after its opening loss and has recent familiarity with Atlanta from three straight wins in the series. The Panthers’ clearest defensive route is to create long downs and pressure Rush, while Atlanta needs its run game and protection to keep the offense out of obvious passing situations.
2026_02_CAR_ATL.model_rationale: Atlanta’s ability to protect Cooper Rush and stay ahead of the chains will determine whether Carolina can dictate obvious passing situations and compress the Falcons’ offense.
